briefing: Stocks fell sharply today: the NASDAQ dropped 3.6% and the S&P 500 lost 2.2%, so the screener returned no buy candidates. We are holding all seven positions with no new buys and keeping $545.88 in cash. The automatic stop-losses and profit targets will handle exits, so there is no reason to sell in a panic.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like tech and growth stocks, moving money into safer places like cash or bonds. On these days fast-growing stocks usually fall the most, which is why the NASDAQ dropped more than the S&P 500 today. A disciplined strategy often stops buying on risk-off days and waits for calmer conditions instead of trying to catch a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者轉趨審慎，沽售科技股、成長股等較高風險資產，並將資金轉投現金或債券等較安全的資產。在這類交易日，高增長股份往往跌幅最大，這正是今日納指跌幅大於標普500的原因。紀律嚴謹的投資策略通常會在避險日暫停買入，等待市況回穩，而非急於「接飛刀」。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks sold off broadly today. The tech-heavy NASDAQ fell 3.6% and the S&P 500 fell 2.2%, a clear risk-off session in which investors moved away from growth and high-valuation names. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't point to a specific cause, but tech falling harder than the broad index fits investors cutting their most volatile, momentum-driven holdings first.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面受壓，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數重挫3.6%，標普500指數亦下跌2.2%，市場明顯轉趨避險，資金撤離成長股及高估值板塊。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫難確定具體觸發因素；不過科技股跌幅遠超大市，反映投資者傾向率先減持波動性最高、動能主導的持倉。
